name: Stone Lodge
address: Stone Lodge, Monabrika, Freshford, Co. Kilkenny
bedsNote: Bedroom 5 is on the ground floor
tagline: An extended stone cottage in good order on just over an acre, under a kilometre from Freshford village and 15 minutes from Kilkenny city.

pros.detail: Bedroom 5 is downstairs, near the utility room/guest WC; four more doubles upstairs.
0.42 ha / 1.04 acres, meeting the 1-acre target for the dogs.
Freshford NS, about 201 pupils; walkable. Clontubrid NS (2.1 km) as a fallback.
About 2,000 sq ft, mid-range of the 140–280 m² target.
Freshford's square, Mace shop and pubs are under 1 km; listed as in excellent order, so no restoration project.
St Luke's 24-hour ED and Kilkenny station are both about 15 km.
Electronic gates with intercom help keep the vizslas in; the outbuildings suit storage, a workshop or kennels.
St Kieran's College, Kilkenny (boys, 100% to third level in 2023); the nearest, Coláiste Mhuire Johnstown, is a DEIS school.

cons.text: Ground floor has a WC, not a shower
cons.detail: Only a utility/guest WC is listed downstairs; parents would climb for a shower unless one is added (rough €8–15k).
Heat pump and insulation upgrade a rough €30–50k before SEAI grants.
Kilkenny MacDonagh station is about 15–20 minutes by car, then about 1h30 to Heuston.
Three months on the market; worth asking why, and room to negotiate.
Ask for a water test and the septic tank's age and certification. Virgin Media broadband, with fibre on the road.
